result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom tab bar all render consistently. Excluding the expected carousel edge-clipping and bottom viewport cutoff, only minor visual inconsistencies remain: the promo banner's decorative circles are clipped at the banner's right edge, and the partially visible category chip at the right edge lacks a visible label, which may read as an empty pill.

issues.description: The decorative translucent circles in the green promo banner are cut off abruptly at the banner's right edge, producing a hard clipped arc rather than a smooth overflow.
issues.suggestion: Either inset the decorative circles fully within the banner bounds or apply overflow clipping with a softer gradient fade so the shapes appear intentional.

issues.description: A category chip is partially visible at the right edge of the filter row but shows no label text within the visible portion, appearing as an empty gray pill.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the next chip's label starts close enough to its left padding that at least part of the text is visible when the chip peeks into view, signaling scrollability.
